title: Dispatch cwd hazards: silent unknown-param drop + daemon-cwd default (worktree facet ADDRESSED)
wanted_capability: Original facet ADDRESSED and live-verified 2026-06-10: in-session worktree creation is host-owned (a72a216 fails closed) and dispatch project_dir flows --cwd → ToolCx.root, so file/content/shell tools resolve in the dispatched worktree (probe d09ad4f8: relative file_write landed in /tmp/ts-cwd-probe, primary + $HOME untouched). TWO RESIDUAL FACETS, same silent-wrong-tree hazard class, found by negative probe 05ee55e7: (1) bro_exec silently DROPS unknown params — dispatching with cwd: instead of project_dir: raised no error, and the bro ran somewhere else entirely; want serde deny_unknown_fields (or equivalent) on dispatch param structs, plus accepting cwd as an alias for project_dir since both the roster DTO and the harness call it cwd. (2) When project_dir is omitted, in-process harness sessions default to the DAEMON's process cwd — $HOME under launchd — so a file-capable bro gets the operator's home directory as its confinement root and writes land there (probe wrote $HOME/probe-cwd-marker.txt). Want: file-capable dispatches without project_dir to fail closed (or default to a neutral scratch dir), with an explicit opt-in for daemon-cwd if any legit use exists.
missing_primitive: dispatch-time cwd override / session workdir tool
fallback_used: Brief-level instruction to use absolute paths + --manifest-path/--target-dir pinning on every cargo command; orchestrator mid-run bro_steer recovery (copy-to-worktree + git checkout -- restore of primary) when a bro falls into the trap.
evidence: probe 05ee55e7-6043-49ac-abe6-76c147643b6e: bro_exec with cwd:/tmp/ts-cwd-probe silently ignored; INSPECTED=/Users/invidious; wrote $HOME/probe-cwd-marker.txt
probe d09ad4f8-191a-4bf7-9066-9f486184ef20: bro_exec with project_dir:/tmp/ts-cwd-probe; INSPECTED=/private/tmp/ts-cwd-probe; relative file_write confined correctly

crates/bro-harness/src/agent_loop.rs:633-640 (--cwd → ToolCx.root; falls back to process cwd)
resolution_note: All three facets fixed and live-probed. Facet 1 (in-session worktree creation → file tools sticky to launch root): closed by a72a216 (host-owned worktree creation, in-session fails closed) + project_dir→--cwd→ToolCx.root wiring; positive probe d09ad4f8 confirmed relative file writes confine to the dispatched worktree. Facet 2 (silent unknown-param drop): 830c2c0 deny_unknown_fields + cwd alias on ExecParams/ResumeParams, extended by 4dda50a to all 48 bro param structs after a third same-day incident (bro_wait timeout_secs misspelling → unbounded wait); live-verified when the fresh binary loudly rejected the verifier's own misnamed param. Facet 3 ($HOME default): 830c2c0 scratch-dir fail-closed at the spawn choke point — no project_dir ⇒ per-task <store>/scratch/<task-id>, never the daemon's process cwd. Forward work (pin:*.project_dir population so wrong-tree model args get refused, not just defaulted) tracked in thread-55d51135 / design/bro-harness/tool-arg-defaulting.md.
